description: Create stunning large-scale network graphs right inside Power BI with Astra, the high-performance visual that handles up to 1 million edges. Bring your complex relationships and data dependencies into clear focus with intuitive navigation, powerful analytics, and customizable design—perfect for everything from cybersecurity threat mapping to social network analysis. MAIN FEATURES Massive Scale: Handle networks with up to 1 million edges. Harness Astra’s optimized rendering engine to confidently explore your largest data sets without compromising speed or performance. Advanced Graph Layouts: Automatically position nodes using industry-leading algorithms that reveal community structures, key influencers, and hidden patterns—all at a glance. Hierarchical & Cluster Navigation: Go beyond static graphs. Drill into sub-clusters, expand or collapse node groups, and smoothly traverse hierarchical structures so users can explore data at their own depth. Interactive On-Chart Controls: Select nodes and edges directly on the graph, drag to reposition clusters, and highlight paths or neighbors with a single click. Even novice users can dive deep with ease. Rich Customization: Tailor node shapes, colors, labels, and tooltips to match your brand or highlight critical data. With dozens of styling options, Astra adapts to any analytic scenario. Cross-Chart Filtering: Seamlessly integrate Astra…
